basis.value_representation: Unmodified DuckDB CAST AS VARCHAR; SQL NULL is JSON null. Keys use the unchanged historical L0 normalization.

edits.old: md5(concat_ws('|', coalesce(CAST(visitor_id AS VARCHAR), ''), coalesce(CAST(timestamp AS VARCHAR), ''), coalesce(CAST(guide_id AS VARCHAR), ''), coalesce(CAST(account_id AS VARCHAR), '')))
edits.new: CASE WHEN account_id IS NOT NULL AND guide_id IS NOT NULL AND timestamp IS NOT NULL AND visitor_id IS NOT NULL THEN md5(concat(coalesce(CAST(visitor_id AS VARCHAR), ''), coalesce(CAST(timestamp AS VARCHAR), ''), coalesce(CAST(account_id AS VARCHAR), ''), coalesce(server_name, ''), coalesce(CAST(guide_id AS VARCHAR), ''), coalesce(user_agent, ''), coalesce(remote_ip, ''))) ELSE NULL END

edits.old: CASE WHEN url IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(url AS VARCHAR)), '') END
edits.new: CASE WHEN TRIM(url) = '' THEN NULL WHEN url IS NOT NULL AND url ~ '^https?://' THEN TRIM(url) ELSE NULL END
CASE WHEN latitude BETWEEN -90 AND 90 THEN CAST(latitude AS DOUBLE) ELSE NULL END
